title: Whole Mount DNA Fluorescence In Situ Hybridisation on Planococcus citri Tissue
author: Maria Kupper
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p9vdr66

steps.title: Tissue Isolation and Fixation
steps.instruction: Isolate Planococcus citri tissues (e.g., ovaries from virgin/mated females or bacteriomes from 2nd/3rd instars) in ice-cold 1xPBS.

substeps.instruction: Transfer samples to 1.5ml tubes containing one of three fixatives: 4% PFA in 1xPBS, 4% PFA in 1xPBS supplemented with 1% Triton X-100, or Carnoy's fixative (Ethanol-Chloroform-Acetic acid; 6:3:1).

steps.title: Washing and Dehydration
steps.instruction: Wash and dehydrate the fixed samples through an ethanol series.

substeps.instruction: For PFA and PFA-Triton fixed samples: wash three times for 5 minutes each in 1xPBS.
Pellet floating tissues by mild centrifugation to max. 8000xg for a few seconds.
Maintain a small residue of reagents in the tube to prevent desiccation.
Incubate samples in an increasing ethanol series at RT for 30 minutes, repeating twice for each concentration: 30%, 50%, 70%, and 90% (Carnoy's fixed samples only 70-90%).
Optional: Store samples in 90% EtOH at 4ºC.

steps.title: Pre-hybridization and Probe Incubation
steps.instruction: Pre-incubate samples and hybridize with oligonucleotide probes.

substeps.instruction: Pre-incubate samples for 30 minutes at 46ºC in hybridization buffer (35% formamide, 900 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris/HCl pH 7.5, 0.2% SDS).

Remove hybridization buffer and add fresh buffer containing 500 nM of required oligonucleotide probes: b91 (5'-GCCTTAGCCCGTGCTGCCGTAC-3', Cy5 modified 5'-end for Tremblaya princeps) and/or g630 (5'- CGAGACTCTAGCCTATCAGTTTC-3', Cy3 modified 5'end for Moranella endobia).
Incubate samples with probes for 2-3 hours at 46ºC in the dark.

steps.title: Post-hybridization Washing and Counterstaining
steps.instruction: Wash the hybridized samples and apply a nuclear counterstain.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples in washing buffer (70 mM NaCl, 20 mM Tris/HCl pH 7.5, 5 mM EDTA, 0.01% SDS) for 30 minutes at 48ºC in the dark.
Remove washing buffer and add 1xPBS with Hoechst (1:1000).
Counterstain for 30 minutes at RT in the dark.

steps.title: Final Washing and Mounting
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and mount tissues for microscopy.

substeps.instruction: Wash samples twice for 10 minutes in 1xPBS.
Wash samples once for 10 minutes in dH2O.
Transfer tissue samples to microscopy slides and slightly air-dry to fix them.
Mount samples in FluorSave TM Reagent.
